# চাঁদগাঁও প্রবাসী ও যুবসমাজ কল্যান ফাউন্ডেশন

> A non-profit charitable foundation run by expatriates and youth of Chandgaon, Bangladesh — humanitarian relief, education, healthcare, and community welfare.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission, activities overview, and donation entry point.
- [About](/about): Foundation history, mission, vision, and team.
- [Activities](/activities): Published programs and recent initiatives.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming and completed events.
- [Notices](/notices): Official notices and announcements.
- [Donate](/donate): Make a donation to the foundation.
- [Donation Tracking](/donations): Verify a donation by TX ID.
- [Membership](/membership): Apply for foundation membership.
- [Help Request](/help): Submit a request for assistance.
- [Track Application](/track): Track a help/membership application.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of programs and events.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact information.
